raw_snippet: We show that this feedback is a sufficient signal for continual learning when the frozen model is paired with an external memory that distils each episode into retrievable natural-language rules.
note: Tablan, Taylor, Bernhem, 'Learning on the Job': the Appendix E L1 exemplar. Frozen weights, feedback distilled into retrievable rules; the abstract states pass^1 1.6x (verdict) to 2.6x (corrections) over static RAG on tau-bench banking, with cross-model transfer of the store.
